readerCopy.headline: The opening needs movement.
readerCopy.body:
A plan that has been sitting around may finally have an obvious first step. Someone is receptive. The timing works. You have enough nerve to make the request instead of rehearsing it for another week. The opportunity becomes real because you move toward it.

Jupiter sextile Mars favors action with a clear target. Send the proposal, make the call, begin the training, or start the task that has been waiting for momentum. Do enough to open the next door, then let the response tell you what deserves more effort.
